title: Inuyama chert quiz
description: After watching "The rocks under Inuyama Castle were once on the deep-sea floor?", do you remember how they got there?

questions.question: What are the thin, layered rocks by the river at Inuyama called?
questions.explanation: Chert forms mainly from the skeletons of tiny deep-sea organisms settling on the sea floor, layer by layer.

questions.question: How did deep-sea chert end up at Inuyama?
options: The sea retreated and exposed the sea floor
A river washed it down from the mountains
It rode an ocean plate to a trench and was scraped onto the edge of the continent
questions.explanation: As the ocean plate sank beneath the continent, the chert on top was scraped off and, over a very long time, became land.

questions.question: How does the chert from the extinction differ from the usual kind?
options: The usual chert is red; that layer is black
The usual chert is black; that layer is white
questions.explanation: The colour depends on the iron inside, so scientists think the deep sea may have lost its oxygen at the time.
